**Release gate: no notifications.** This policy emails no one. Its incidents exist so the release gate in server/deploy/README.md ("Release verification and rollback") can read them with `gcloud monitoring alerts list`.

Conditions (rolling 5 minutes, per service or job): any 5xx; any ERROR log entry (`milton-errors`); any failed `milton-auth-*` execution; any startup failure or crash exit (`milton-startup-failures`); 10 or more 429s. The 7-day backtest shows these open only around releases and deploy errors, plus one 429 burst (48 in 3 minutes on MCP, 11-07 10:55Z), which is why 429 needs 10, not 1.

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = one_of("milton-app", "milton-mcp", "milton-auth") AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"

conditions.displayName: gate: any ERROR log entry in 5 min

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "logging.googleapis.com/user/milton-errors" AND resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = one_of("milton-app", "milton-mcp", "milton-auth")

conditions.displayName: gate: any failed job execution in 5 min

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = one_of("milton-auth-mail", "milton-auth-maint") AND metric.labels.result = "failed"

conditions.displayName: gate: any startup failure in 5 min

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "logging.googleapis.com/user/milton-startup-failures" AND resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = one_of("milton-app", "milton-mcp", "milton-auth")

metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = one_of("milton-app", "milton-mcp", "milton-auth") AND metric.labels.response_code = "429"
